# Syntaxis

> Syntaxis is a Ukrainian studio of three engineers building custom websites and web applications for clients in Ukraine and worldwide. Prices are agreed per project after a short call.

## Services

- Websites and landing pages
- Web applications: portals, CRMs, SaaS, dashboards
- Interface design and design systems
- Backend and APIs, including Ukrainian payment and delivery integrations
- DevOps and cloud infrastructure
- Security audits and hardening
- Technical SEO
- Performance optimisation (Core Web Vitals)
- Outstaffing: a frontend, backend or DevOps engineer for your team, hourly or part-time, from one week

## On the page

Interactive, realistic demos of the work: an IDE with a live preview and dev-server log, a design tool, an API client, a deployment dashboard, browser DevTools with security headers, a Lighthouse report with a loading filmstrip, a pull request with a diff, and a Telegram brief. An Explain mode describes each window in plain language. The demo store "Zerno" is fictional.

## Terms

- Fixed price for an agreed scope, estimate within 48 hours
- Payment in stages
- 12 months of free bug fixes after launch (bugs against the agreed specification; redesigns, rewrites and new features are estimated separately)
- Code, design files and access belong to the client
- PageSpeed 90+ on mobile for sites built from scratch, measured at handover and written into the contract
